recognize_zh: 血片呈明顯大小不一與異形紅血球：大量低色素小球性細胞、標靶細胞、碎片與淚滴狀細胞，同時混有飽滿的正常色素細胞（箭頭處為小而緻密的球形細胞），符合嚴重地中海型貧血。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with many hypochromic microcytes
Target cells, teardrop cells, and irregular red cell fragments
Dimorphic picture with a subpopulation of well-hemoglobinized normocytes
Small dense round red cell (arrow), microspherocyte-like
Few platelets; no nucleated red cells in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous hypochromic microcytes, target cells, teardrop cells, and irregular red cell fragments. A second population of well-hemoglobinized normocytic cells is present, producing a dimorphic picture, and small dense microspherocyte-like cells are seen (arrow). Nucleated red cells are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a severe thalassemia syndrome (e.g., beta-thalassemia major/intermedia or HbH disease), with the dimorphic population possibly reflecting transfusion.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency rarely produces this degree of poikilocytosis, fragments, and target cells, and has low ferritin rather than normal/increased iron stores.
MAHA shows helmet cells and schistocytes in a normochromic background with thrombocytopenia, not diffuse hypochromic microcytosis with target cells.
HPP shows striking microspherocytes and budding fragments with very low MCV but lacks hypochromia and target cells, and has spectrin defects.
Sideroblastic anemia gives a dimorphic hypochromic population but with Pappenheimer bodies and ring sideroblasts, and normal globin chain studies.
